svg.title: Live seagoing test bench: Boston Whaler Conquest plant, bus, and isolation
svg.desc: Installer-facing boxology on the same stern-first Boston Whaler Conquest hull as the slip graphic. Left: AC, DC, SeaTalk NG, and isolation rules a marine electrician checks. Right: two independent 120 V 30 A dock feeds; SeaTalk NG with T-pieces including dual Raymarine Axiom+ 9 chartplotters and VesselView. Helm interface is that SeaTalk NG / NMEA 2000 bus. The cluster meets the helm only through a listen-only YDEN-03. A parallel later NMEA OneNet PoE++ Ethernet backbone runs stern to bow beside SeaTalk NG, with taps so sensors can land anywhere an STNG device might. Fused house 12 V to each computer. SignalK MCP / agentic processor after storage to an additional display that is not the Axiom+ and not throttle.
svg.text: Same Boston Whaler Conquest hull. Plant, bus, and isolation a marine electrician checks. 0183 stays compatible.

House is 12 V — do not series to 24 V.

Do not land raw 0183 on the listen spur.
